itemdesc-gameboard-generic: Place on the ground to make all possible boards
itemdesc-schematic-generic_piece: Used for creating all possible pieces
itemdesc-chiseledpiece:
Chiseled piece
Protip: Chisel blocks facing in one direction

Press toolmodeselect key (Tool Mode) to manipulate with it in various ways.
itemdesc-dice-classic_cube: A six-sided die with a cube shape. Rolls a random number from 1 to 6.
itemdesc-dice-doubling_cube: A six-sided die with a cube shape used in Backgammon. Rolls values of 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, or 64.
itemdesc-dice-d4: A four-sided die with a tetrahedron shape. Rolls a random number from 1 to 4.
itemdesc-dice-d6: A six-sided die with a cube shape. Rolls a random number from 1 to 6.
itemdesc-dice-d8: An eight-sided die with an octahedron shape. Rolls a random number from 1 to 8.
itemdesc-dice-d12: A twelve-sided die with a dodecahedron shape. Rolls a random number from 1 to 12.
itemdesc-dice-d20: A twenty-sided die with an icosahedron shape. Rolls a random number from 1 to 20.
toolmode-sinkslot-pigment-changeboardlin: Drag and drop pigment here to change color of lines on the board
toolmode-sinkslot-pigment-backgammon-cha: Drag and drop pigment here to change the primary color of the drawings on the board.
Drag and drop pigment here to change the secondary color of the drawings on the board.
toolmode-sinkslot-pigment-dice-changedot: Drag and drop pigment here to change the color of dots or numbers on the dice.
toolmode-dice-reset: Reset the dice to its default state.
toolmode-sinkslot-convert-chiseled-block: Drag and drop chiseled block here to create chiseled piece (bulk action: hold shift key)
toolmode-sinkslot-exchange-chiseled-bloc: Drag and drop chiseled block here to exchange it with main chiseled block
toolmode-remove-chiseled-block: Remove main chiseled block with empty click
toolmode-sinkslot-up-add-chiseled-block: Drag and drop chiseled block here to add it above
toolmode-sinkslot-down-add-chiseled-bloc: Drag and drop chiseled block here to add it below
inworldcraftingdesc-chessboardinfo: Start constructing a chessboard by adding any 2x planks or 2x stones. Use <hk>rightmouse</hk> to create dark tiles.
inworldcraftingdesc-goboardinfo: Convert to Go Board by using any pigment with <hk>rightmouse</hk> to draw lines.
inworldcraftingdesc-item-gameboard-chess: Add any 2x planks or 2x stones with <hk>rightmouse</hk> to create light tiles.
Use a chisel to make it functional.
trivia-chessboard: Can also be used as a checkerboard.
trivia-chesspiece-king: The most important piece; protect it at all costs.
trivia-chesspiece-knight: Has unique movement in an 'L' shape.
trivia-chesspiece-pawn: The pawns are the soul of chess.
trivia-chesspiece-queen: The most powerful piece, combining rook and bishop movements.
trivia-chesspiece-rook: Moves in straight lines horizontally or vertically.
trivia-checkerpiece: Can be flipped to switch between pawn and king.
trivia-goboard-9x9: Go board. Ideal for beginners to learn Go.
trivia-goboard-13x13: Go board. Well-suited for intermediate players.
trivia-goboard-15x15: Go board. Primarily used to play gomoku.
trivia-goboard-17x17: Go board. Historically used before the 19x19 board became the standard.
trivia-goboard-19x19: Go board. The standard board for playing Go.
trivia-morrisboard-three: A simplified version of Morris, great for quick games.
trivia-morrisboard-six: Can also be used for five men's morris.
trivia-morrisboard-nine: The classic Nine Men's Morris game.
trivia-morrisboard-twelve: Can also be used for eleven men's morris.
trivia-shogipiece: Used to play shogi, also known as Japanese chess.
trivia-shogiboard: Shogi board. Used to play shogi, also known as Japanese chess.
trivia-shogistand: A stand for holding captured Shogi pieces.
trivia-gobowl: A traditional bowl used to store Go stones.
trivia-gobowl-lid: Here go captured Go stones of your opponent.

craftinginfo-starterguide-text:
Tabletop Games Starter Guide

Create generic board
Once you create Generic board, place it on the ground and follow instructions in tooltip.

Create schematic
Made by interacting with any pigment on parchment placed on the ground.

Create pieces
With schematic in active hand, press toolmodeselect key (Tool Mode) to open menu for creating pieces.
craftinginfo-custompiecesguide-text:
Tabletop Games Custom Pieces Guide

With schematic in active hand, press toolmodeselect key (Tool Mode), find a mode with a chisel tool icon, then follow instructions in the description.

To change dimension limit, use following commands:
/worldconfig tabletopgames_chiseledPieceMaxUp : Sets the maximum number of chiseled blocks that can be added above
/worldconfig tabletopgames_chiseledPieceMaxDown : Sets the maximum number of chiseled blocks that can be added below
